statement: the noise-tolerance q/n could be improved by increasing n. Can this observation be formalized in general? Specifically, for a fixed, arbitrary soundness error, what choice of n maximizes the quantity q/n? Answering this exactly requires analysis of the expression for |Eq |2 ε. For low noise, the bound in equation (54) could be used to perhaps simplify the analysis. Is it possible to obtain noise-tolerance for other public-key quantum money schemes? In section 1.3, we mentioned some of the other public-key quantum money schemes that rely on hardness assumptions instead of oracles. Is it possible to make any of these schemes noise-tolerant?
